task: W2-54 run 5 (DAEO-0rfi): revise `tests/unit/check/test_the_other_types_of_w2_02_stay_unknown` so it checks W2-54's own commits rather than the tree (DEC-874 item 1), with no code change.
status: DONE. The sandbox check passed ((a) was refused, (b) exited 0), the revised test passes on `HEAD` and on `4ce16df2`, the red demonstration fails as it should, and commit `40909d21` exists.
work_completed: Step 0 and the start checks all matched what was expected. The old test asserted that `close` and `adoption-verdict` are absent from `schema.SCHEMA_MAP` in the tree. I replaced it with a small git-only helper in the same file. The helper lists the non-merge commits whose `Task:` trailer is `DAEO-0rfi` (`git log --no-merges --format=%H%x09%(trailers:key=Task,valueonly,...)`). It then checks each commit against its parent: `git show --no-renames --name-status` for an added `close.schema.json` or `adoption-verdict.schema.json`, and `git show -U0 -- src/gov/check/schema.py` for an added line that puts `"close"` or `"adoption-verdict"` into `SCHEMA_MAP` (as a key) or into a `STANDALONE_TYPES` line. A failure names the commit. `test_the_other_types_of_w2_02_stay_unknown` keeps its name and is now parametrised over `HEAD` and `4ce16df2`. A new test, `test_the_reading_of_w2_54_own_commits_fails_only_on_its_own`, builds a repository from scratch in `tmp_path`. It runs 4 kinds of break (close in SCHEMA_MAP, adoption-verdict in STANDALONE_TYPES, a close schema file, an adoption-verdict schema file) × 2 tasks. A `DAEO-0rfi` commit must raise an AssertionError that names its sha; a `DAEO-zflj` commit must pass. No other test or file changed, nothing under `src/` changed, and nothing was deleted or skipped.

After the change, the same file: 19 passed, including `test_the_other_types_of_w2_02_stay_unknown[HEAD]`, `[4ce16df2]` and the 8 cases `test_the_reading_of_w2_54_own_commits_fails_only_on_its_own[DAEO-0rfi-True-close-in-schema-map | -adoption-verdict-in-standalone-types | -close-schema-file | -adoption-verdict-schema-file, DAEO-zflj-False-<same four>]`. Acceptance suites were not run, as they are the lead's.
discoveries: `HEAD` is not an ancestor of `4ce16df2` (`merge-base --is-ancestor` gives 1), because HEAD holds the test designer's `49f1f81e`, the merge `de42a87d` and now `40909d21`. `4ce16df2` holds 38 of W2-54's own commits and HEAD holds 40 (39 before mine). All of W2-54's code commits are in both histories, as DEC-874 says. `gov retrieve` returned no evidence: `FACET_UNAVAILABLE`, lexical and semantic both `stale`.
risks: The test needs commit `4ce16df2` in the object store. A clone without W2-02's branch would make the `[4ce16df2]` case error rather than skip. The line check matches a quoted key (`"close":`) or a `STANDALONE_TYPES` line that holds the name. A `STANDALONE_TYPES` tuple split across lines with the name alone on a continuation line would not be caught. W2-54's own history has no such form.
lessons: Read W2-54's own change by its `Task:` trailer with `--no-merges` and `--no-renames`, so that merges of `w2/integrate` and renames do not hide what a commit adds. Building the temporary repository with `GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null` and `GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1` keeps it free of the user's git settings.
